title: Can I Win
description: Players alternate choosing unused integers from 1 through `maxChoosableInteger` and add each choice to a running total. The first player to make the total reach or exceed `desiredTotal` wins. Both play optimally. Return true if the first player can force a win.
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.
